available.quote: On payment of the appropriate fee and submission and acceptance of a written application on forms provided by the Board, the Board shall grant a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene to each applicant who presents proof of current licensure in "good standing" in another state, the District of Columbia, or territory of the United States
available.citation: § 1124. Dentists and dental hygienists licensed in other jurisdictions.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold current license in good standing in another state, DC, or US territory; for dentists: degree from CODA-accredited school, 3 years active dental practice in another jurisdiction, meet other § 1122 requirements; must be academically current through CE or otherwise as determined by the Board; valid CPR certification required.
requirements.quote: Has submitted proof that the applicant has had 3 years of active dental practice in another state, the District of Columbia, or a territory of the United States.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or cooperating in fraud or deception to acquire a license, impersonating a licensee, or aiding an unlicensed person to represent themselves as a dentist or dental hygienist.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed or knowingly cooperated in fraud or material deception in order to acquire a license as a dentist or dental hygienist, has impersonated another person holding a license or has allowed another person to use the practitioner's license, or has aided or abetted a person not licensed as a dentist or dental hygienist to represent himself or herself as a dentist or dental hygienist;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry or dental hygiene in an incompetent or grossly negligent manner, or engaging in misconduct or unprofessional conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced dentistry or dental hygiene in an incompetent or grossly negligent manner or has otherwise been guilty of misconduct or unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any offense the circumstances of which substantially relate to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of any offense the circumstances of which substantially relate to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in consumer fraud or deception, illegal restraint of competition, or illegal price-fixing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in an act of consumer fraud or deception, engaged in the illegal restraint of competition, or participated in illegal price-fixing activities;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of this chapter or any regulation established thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated a provision of this chapter or any regulation established thereunder;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license suspended, revoked, or subject to other disciplinary action in another jurisdiction, where the underlying grounds constitute acts prohibited by this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had the practitioner's license as a dentist or dental hygienist suspended or revoked, or has had other disciplinary action taken against the dentist or dental hygienist by the appropriate licensing authority in another jurisdiction;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the Board that the practitioner's license in another state has been subject to discipline, surrender, suspension, or revocation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to notify the Board that the practitioner's license as a dentist or dental hygienist in another state has been subject to discipline or has been surrendered, suspended or revoked.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a physical condition such that the performance of dentistry or dental hygiene is or may be injurious or prejudicial to the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having DEA prescribing privileges restricted or revoked.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had the practitioner's United States Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) privileges restricted or revoked;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the excessive use or abuse of drugs.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in the excessive use or abuse of drugs;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Maintaining a facility in an unsanitary or unsafe condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has maintained a facility in an unsanitary or unsafe condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony sexual offense.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a felony sexual offense;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report child abuse or neglect as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report child abuse or neglect as required by § 903 of Title 16, or any successor thereto;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the Division of Professional Regulation as required by § 1131A.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report to the Division of Professional Regulation as required by § 1131A of this title.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No person licensed under this chapter shall perform any office-based surgery, as defined in § 122(3)y. of Title 16, in a facility unless such facility is accredited or licensed in accordance with § 122(3)z. of Title 16.
establishment_regulation_required.citation: § 1138. Accreditation of facilities where office-based surgeries are performed.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of dentistry" is defined as the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and treatment (nonsurgical, surgical or related procedures) of diseases, disorders and conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body provided by a dentist within the scope of the dentist's education, training and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law.

drug_authority.value: Dentists licensed by this State may prescribe any drug necessary in the practice of dentistry, dental surgery, or oral surgery; pharmacists licensed by this State may fill such prescriptions. Electronic prescribing is generally required with enumerated exceptions.
drug_authority.quote: Pharmacists licensed by this State may fill prescriptions of dentists licensed by this State for any drug necessary in the practice of dentistry, dental surgery or oral surgery.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: No person shall repair, construct, adjust or alter any appliance, denture or dental restoration except under the authorization and responsibility of a licensed practitioner of dentistry as defined by this chapter.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: The names of dentists who have practiced under the trade name shall be maintained in the records of the dental facility for at least 5 years following their departure from the practice.
patient_record_retention_years.citation: § 1171. Name used in practice of dentistry.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: Shall submit proof of current certification in cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) technique in accordance with regulations adopted by the Board.
